Ottawa pivots to aerospace, defense readiness, and digital procurement. 🚀

### Aerospace & Aviation
The Canadian Transportation Agency cleared international charter flight operations connecting European origins directly to Canadian regional nodes, while Transport Canada tendered comprehensive administration, operations, and maintenance services for the Îles de la Madeleine Airport. Non-compliance with charter flight authorizations risks immediate groundings, and failure to attend mandatory site visits for airport operations results in bid disqualification. Advisory practices can structure specialized aviation compliance retainers and support infrastructure management firms with pre-bid site assessments and Safety Management Systems.

### Trade Compliance & Legal Proceedings
The Canadian International Trade Tribunal formally initiated an expiry review concerning small power transformers imported from Chinese Taipei and Korea while enforcing strict page limits and formatting standards for Special Import Measures Act proceedings effective October 1, 2026. Domestic producers face market injury risks if anti-dumping measures expire without a positive determination by the Canada Border Services Agency by February 2026 and the Tribunal by August 2026, alongside mandatory 70-page submission limits. Trade advisory firms and legal consultants can package specialized SIMA evidentiary preparation, market participation, and document compliance reviews.

### Rail & Freight Logistics
New freight adjudication proceedings opened regarding railway noise and vibration compliance under national transportation rules. Rail freight operators face potential contractual default and administrative penalties arising from unresolved noise and vibration disputes, requiring logistics providers to review line-haul service level agreements and audit corridor telemetry. Advisory practices and trade consultants can package specialized rail-freight SLA renegotiation and dispute-resolution advisory services for affected shippers.
